## Compare the Per Head Sensitivity Map Between Low Counts and Higher Counts Simulation

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

for (i in 1:80) {
  cat(sprintf("### Dectcor Head %d Comparison\n\n", i))
  # 1. Start the layout div and assign the MAIN figure ID
  cat(sprintf("::: {#fig-pair-%d layout-ncol=2}\n\n", i))
  
  # 2. Print Image A with its sub-caption and SUB-ID (a)
  cat(sprintf("![Detector Head %d, High MC Simulation Counts](figs/1_25_tri_counts/high_stats_sensitivity_map_z_stacked_srm_head_%d.png){#fig-pair-%da}\n\n", i, i, i))
  
  # 3. Print Image B with its sub-caption and SUB-ID (b)
  cat(sprintf("![Detector Head %d, Low MC Simulation Counts](figs/low_counts_1_mm_box/z_stacked_srm_head_%d.png){#fig-pair-%db}\n\n", i, i, i))
  
  # 4. Print the main overarching caption for the pair
  cat(sprintf("Comparing Detector Head %d.\n\n", i))
  
  # 5. Close the layout div
  cat(":::\n\n")
}
```

## Linear Equation Method for Finding the Unexpected Pixels

We use the following form of the linear boundary for easier calculation:
$$
a x + b y = c
$$

For any point in the region above the line, it satisfies:
$$
ax+by>c
$$
and for points in the region below the line:
$$
ax+by<c
$$

for a line passing through $(x_1,y_1)$ and $(x_2, y_2)$, we have the line equation:
$$
y-y_1 = \frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}(x-x_1)
$$
thus,
$$
\begin{aligned}
a &= y_2-y_1 \\
b &= x_1-x_2 \\
c &= (x_1-x_2) \cdot y_1 + (y_2-y_1) \cdot x_1 = x_1 y_2 - x_2 y_1
\end{aligned}
$$

## Low Counts Simulation Comparision of 1 mm tungsten box vs 2 mm tungsten box
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

for (i in 1:80) {
  cat(sprintf("### Dectcor Head %d\n\n", i))
  # 1. Start the layout div and assign the MAIN figure ID
  cat(sprintf("::: {#fig-sensitivity-shielding-box-%d layout-ncol=2}\n\n", i))
  
  # 2. Print Image A with its sub-caption and SUB-ID (a)
  cat(sprintf("![Detector Head %d, 1 mm Shielding Box](figs/box_1_mm/head_%d_sensitivity.png){#fig-sensitivity-shielding-box-%da}\n\n", i, i, i))
  
  # 3. Print Image B with its sub-caption and SUB-ID (b)
  cat(sprintf("![Detector Head %d, 2 mm Shielding Box](figs/box_2_mm/head_%d_sensitivity.png){#fig-sensitivity-shielding-box-%db}\n\n", i, i, i))
  
  # 4. Print the main overarching caption for the pair
  cat(sprintf("Comparing Detector Head %d.\n\n", i))
  
  # 5. Close the layout div
  cat(":::\n\n")
}
```
